title: mapkeeper dense map layer (D-46)
description: Dense, index-addressed map-state layer — mirrors crates/core/src/layer.rs::DenseLayer (scale-layers, D-46). Cells are addressed by linear index within the map bounds (core::hex::MapBounds::index_of), not by cell_id strings. states[i] is 0=unknown, 1=none, 2=value; the value column (codes for categorical, values for integer) is meaningful only where states[i]==2. Categorical values are palette/dictionary-encoded. Evolution of the sparse map-layer.schema.json; profiles are unaffected.

value_type.description: Kind of value the layer stores.

cell_count.description: Number of cells (dense array length), equals MapBounds::len().

palette.description: Categorical dictionary of distinct values; codes[i] indexes into it.

codes.description: Categorical value column (palette index per cell).
